description: Recent past weather for an agricultural region, summarized by day from NOAA station observations: daily high and low temperature (°F), total precipitation (inches), and the number of observations behind each day. Use for what weather actually occurred over the past days; use get_weather instead for current conditions and get_forecast for the outlook. Live proxy to NOAA — nothing is stored; no API key. `days` spans 1–30 (default 7). Precipitation is null for a day when the station reported no precipitation values — never silently zero — and days with no observations are omitted.

days.description: Number of past days to summarize (default 7, max 30)

location.description: Location key (IL-central, IA-central, NE-central, IN-central, KS-central). Default: IL-central

name: get_weather_history
